name: delix-board
description: Live board for delix: cards, gates, long runs and metrics in a pane beside the chat, a band above the prompt, toasts when a run ends. Read-only; does nothing in headless sessions.

extraPatterns.title: Extra wait patterns
extraPatterns.description: Comma-separated regular expressions; a Bash command matching one is tracked in the Wait view, beside the built-in run_all.sh, build.sh, release.sh, gh run watch and docker build.
